name: Four foot undercabinet task bar
origin: Top mounting plane center Z=0; long axis X, body below, emits -Z
allowed_variation: Rigid Z rotation and placement only. Change light power per host instance. No nonuniform scaling.
host_requirements: Mount to cabinet underside near front, with a separate power/cable route. Do not scale length: use repeated bars or a new version for other lengths.
rights: Original project asset; CC BY 4.0; attribution: Homes project contributors
illumination: Low emission diffuser mesh; optional host-owned light via common.lighting_assets.place. Artistic Blender watts, not verified photometry.
